correctness.rationale: Unbounded proof establishes forced balanced pairs and final phase, excludes all within-pair and post-terminal deletions, and bijects every positional deletion embedding with a weak composition of \(\ell+1\) prescribed-parity gaps. Exact binomial fibers and histogram follow. Separate literal-mask and dynamic-interleaving checkers passed 190 complete parameter pairs to n=18, 20,427 independent shuffle cases to n=22 and 500 longer samples.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The cyclic-permutation theorem counts embeddings of the retained target with no constraint on complementary deleted pattern; summing the new fiber multiplicities over residual words recovers the count of embeddings of the deleted pattern, but neither marginal determines the conditional allocation among residuals. The fixed-composition law counts distinct outputs after any deletion set, and does not count multiplicities conditioned on the deleted sequence. Thus neither stronger-looking theorem covers this statement.

value.rationale: The exact per-output positional multiplicity law, rather than the known distinct-output support, supplies a conditional deletion-channel probability distribution and resolves all four source/deletion parity combinations. Fiber size depends only on a phase-switch statistic; complete equality-class histogram and sharp saturation criterion are useful natural structural invariants.
